title: Varken
description: What's playing on Plex, what's in the libraries, and what Sonarr, Radarr, SickChill and Ombi are waiting on? The original Varken dashboard, on Varken's Prometheus metrics.

panels.title: Total Streams
panels.description: Streams playing, paused or buffering now.

panels.title: Direct Play
panels.description: Streams playing the file as it is.

panels.title: LAN BW
panels.description: Bandwidth of the streams to the local network.

panels.title: WAN BW
panels.description: Bandwidth of the streams leaving the local network.

panels.title: Req. Approved
panels.description: Ombi requests approved but not yet available.

panels.title: Issues Pending
panels.description: Ombi issues nobody has picked up.

panels.title: Movies Added
panels.description: How many more movies the movie libraries hold than at their lowest in the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Episodes Added
panels.description: How many more episodes the TV libraries hold than at their lowest in the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Device Types
panels.description: Current sessions by the player's platform.

panels.title: Stream Types
panels.description: Current sessions by video decision (direct play, copy, transcode).

panels.title: Viewer Locations
panels.description: Where the current viewers are, from the GeoLite2 city of each viewer's address. Viewers who can't be placed are left out. Needs `stream_details = true` in Varken.

panels.title: TV Shows on Today (Sonarr)
panels.description: Episodes airing from today through Sonarr's `future_days` (1 by default: today and tomorrow).

panels.title: Users Online
panels.description: Who is watching what, how, and from where. Needs `stream_details = true` in Varken.

panels.title: TV Shows (SickChill)
panels.description: SickChill's coming episodes, and the ones it missed.

panels.title: Missing Available Movies
panels.description: Monitored movies Radarr has no file for, though they are out.

panels.title: Ombi Requests Pending
panels.description: Ombi requests not yet available or denied. The requester is shown only with `stream_details = true` in Varken.

panels.title: Missing TV Shows (Last 7 Days)
panels.description: Monitored episodes without a file that aired in Sonarr's last `missing_days` (7 by default).
